connector: You’ve finished Prince Caspian. All week you watched the story settle its big question. Today, say what that settling means. Not what the book is about, but what it believes, and prove it from the last three chapters.

a.raw: sire said reepicheep my life is ever at your command but my honour is my own
a.fixed: “Sire,” said Reepicheep. “My life is ever at your command, but my honour is my own.”
a.why: Reepicheep’s real words (Chapter 13). Each part of his speech gets quotation marks; capitals on Sire, Reepicheep and My; a comma before but; periods inside the quotation marks.

b.raw: well said peter we have had a time
b.why: The book’s own last lines. Capitals on Well, Peter and We; the exclamation point goes inside the quotation mark; periods end each sentence.

vocab: An invitation to fight or compete that must be answered.
Fighting; single combat is one against one.
To say words aloud for someone else to write down.
An official who oversees a contest and keeps order.
The ceremony of crowning a king or queen.
notes.wordParts: Review of the unit’s bases: port, tract, struct, spect, ject, script/scribe, rupt, duct/duce, form, plus press = push, tain = hold, lev = lift.
notes.grammar: Dialogue punctuation: quotation marks fence off the exact words; the comma or end mark goes inside the closing quotation mark; a tag like said Peter joins with a comma. Editing day.
notes.spelling: Cumulative review: a hard word is often two or three rules stacked up. Take it apart: se + par + ate + ion; forget + t + able.

transcripts.welcome: Hello, it’s Nell. You’ve finished the book. I always sit for a minute with a book I’ve just finished. Today’s question: what does Prince Caspian believe, and what in the ending proves it?
transcripts.read: Say what got settled, what didn’t, and who had to let go of something. Then finish the sentence: this book believes that. Not what it’s about. What it believes. Turn to the page in the ending that proves it.
transcripts.grammar: Editing day, the last one for this book. Check every line of dialogue. Are the exact words inside quotation marks? Is the comma or end mark inside too? Does the tag join with a comma? Fix each one and say why.
